page.layout: One page of text: a heading line at top centre, then a numbered list of questions, ending with a catchword-like signature line "R SE." at the foot. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.head: ET CAPITVM.
main_text.l: 2. Quid sint Constitutiones Principum in genere?
3. An omne Principis placitum lex sit?
10. Utrum omni Principis mandato sit parendum? dist.
14. Utrum rescriptum Principis habeat vim legis?
17. Utrum per subreptionem aut obreptionem vitiata valeant?
20. An rescripti exemplum, an authenticum probet?
21. An error in constructione vitiet rescriptum?
22. An rescriptum Principis strictè sit sumendum?
23. Utrum jus tertio quaesitum per Principem possit auferri?

page.notes: Running text is a list of questions; the bottom "R SE." line is a printed mark, not a catchword. Line 2 and other wrapped lines are continuations as printed ("gene-/re?", "parendum?", "gis?", "leant?", "probet?", "dum?", "possit auferri?"); the page-number line is absent. Some words are heavily blurred (e.g. "subreptionem" reads as "sub aut obreptionem" in the print, copied as printed in intent); the phrase "per sub aut obreptionem" is the printed form and should be checked against the scan.
